articles.summary: Xenia Hotels Resorts, Inc. (NYSE: XHR) ("Xenia" or the "Company") will report financial results for the third quarter 2026 before the market opens on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Management will discuss the Company's results during a conference call at 1:00 pm (Eastern Time) that day. To participate in the conference call, please follow the steps listed below: Tuesday, November 3, 2026, dial (833) 461-5787 approximately ten minutes before the call begins, Meeting ID: 953 553 378. Tell the operator that you are calling for Xenia Hotels Resorts' Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call. State your full name and company affiliation and you will be connected to the call. A live webcast of the earnings call will also be available through the Company's website. To access, log on to www.xeniareit.com ten minutes prior to the call. A replay of the conference call webcast will be archived and available online for 90 days through the Investor Relations section of www.xeniareit.com
articles.title: Xenia Hotels & Resorts Announces Timing of Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
